title: Analyze service uptime and incident frequency
text: Review this CSV with daily uptime % and incident logs for [insert service] over the past quarter. Identify patterns in outages, frequency of issues by severity, and calculate overall uptime. Summarize findings and suggest actions for improvement in a brief report.
problem: Keperluan teknikal untuk “Analyze service uptime and incident frequency” belum dirangka atau diuji.
use: Mereka bentuk produk dan sistem digital
output: Perbandingan/analisis berstruktur dengan penjelasan, sumber atau ukuran yang relevan.
hook: Idea produk ada, tetapi skop, aliran pengguna atau ujian belum tersusun? Fokus: Analyze service uptime and incident frequency.
solution: Tugasan: Analyze service uptime and incident frequency. Tetapkan keperluan fungsi, aliran pengguna, skema data, sempadan keselamatan dan kriteria ujian sebelum membangunkan output.
cta: Jalankan pada spesifikasi sebenar; uji fungsi, kes tepi dan keselamatan sebelum digunakan.
